paraphrase: There is equanimity based on diversity (towards forms, sounds …) and equanimity based on unity (the formless spheres); by depending on the latter one abandons the former, and by non-identification (atammayatā) one abandons even that.

paraphrase: The Teacher establishes mindfulness in three situations — when disciples do not listen, when some listen and some do not, and when all listen — remaining unmoved, neither displeased nor elated, mindful and aware: this makes him fit to instruct a group; he is the incomparable trainer of persons to be tamed.
